scenarios.prompt: A replay ghost from a prior build is loaded on the same track revision. Validate ruleset/schema compatibility and keep playback presentation-only.

criteria.identity: ghost_replay_id, replay schema and source build/ruleset are explicit.
criteria.compatibility: track/world revision and compatibility predicate/fallback are explicit.
criteria.ownership: Ghost playback cannot alter live simulation, rewards, collision or targeting unless another mode explicitly owns interaction.
